title: Declared foreign shortcodes pass through verbatim
format: html

_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["\\{\\{&lt; hugoref foo &gt;\\}\\}"]
        - ["quarto-unresolved-shortcode"]
